# c-capnproto

> Pure C runtime and `capnpc-c` for Cap'n Proto. Wire encode matches official `capnp` 1.0.2 when objects are allocated in schema order.

Docs: https://c-capnproto.rgoswami.me/
Repo: https://github.com/HaoZeke/c-capnproto
Context7: /haozeke/c-capnproto

Use this HaoZeke fork, not opensourcerouting/c-capnproto. Failed pointer hops are `CAPN_NULL`; check `capn_ok`. Call `capn_set_root` before write.

## Docs

- [Install](https://c-capnproto.rgoswami.me/install.html): Meson, CMake, autotools
- [Tutorial](https://c-capnproto.rgoswami.me/tutorial.html): AddressBook write, read, packed, canonical
- [Usage](https://c-capnproto.rgoswami.me/usage.html): capnpc-c, fieldgetset, has_
- [Wire](https://c-capnproto.rgoswami.me/wire.html): schema-order encode, empty struct B=-1, packed 0xFF
- [Interop](https://c-capnproto.rgoswami.me/interop.html): official capnp CLI, fortran goldens, Janet

## Siblings

- [capnp-fortran](https://capnp-fortran.rgoswami.me/): F2018 runtime, plugin, RPC
- [capnp-janet](https://capnp-janet.rgoswami.me/): Janet / embed C wire runtime

## Install

```sh
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/HaoZeke/c-capnproto.git
cd c-capnproto
meson setup build && meson compile -C build
meson test -C build
```

## First message

```c
#include "capnp_c.h"
#include "addressbook.capnp.h"

static capn_text txt(const char *s) {
  return (capn_text){.len = (int)strlen(s), .str = s, .seg = NULL};
}

uint8_t buf[4096];
struct capn c;
capn_init_malloc(&c);

struct Person p = {
  .id = 17,
  .name = txt("Firstname Lastname"),
  .email = txt("username@domain.com"),
};
p.employment_which = Person_employment_school;
p.employment.school = txt("of life");

Person_ptr pp = new_Person(capn_root(&c).seg);
write_Person(&p, pp);
capn_set_root(&c, pp.p);
ssize_t sz = capn_write_mem(&c, buf, sizeof buf, 0);
capn_free(&c);
```
